profile.headline: Senior Staff Software Engineer, Developer Experience & CI @ Block
profile.summary:
I’ve spent the last 17 years in the industry leading people and teams focused on building world-class developer infrastructure, with a special technical focus on scaling CI and making it highly efficient, highly reliable, and highly cost-effective at large and midsize companies operating at millions of builds per month scale.

Over that time, I’ve compiled a track record that includes:

- Designing and delivering new developer tools from the ground up
- Leading efficiency projects that delivered multi-million $$/yr cost reductions
- Leading build outs of infrastructure to power millions of CI jobs per month while maintaining reliability and without ballooning costs
- Successfully unifying disparate CI/CD platforms across large teams (and resolving years of tech debt along the way)
- Defining and driving the technical vision for developer experience across large (1000+ eng) organizations
- Coaching and mentoring IC engineers at all levels 
- Driving product quality improvement initiatives and building cultures of engineering excellence

positions.title: Staff Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Technical Lead for CI: Set strategy & direction, defined company-wide standards & paved roads
- Discover, design, and drive developer productivity improvements with the most ROI for Coinbase engineers

Highlighted Results:

- Successfully designed, built, deployed, and migrated the company to a fully Kubernetes-based CI infrastructure. Cut annual CI cost by 60+% (Multi-million $ spend) while reducing CI wait times & improving reliability
- Launched GitHub Actions internally for code automation at Coinbase, drove adoption
- Scaled CI infrastructure to support 5x job growth (1M jobs/mo => over 5M jobs/mo), including use as the largest AI agent platform at the company
- Drove and completed CI unification effort; moved thousands of repositories from several distinct CI platforms to one unified platform
- Mentored and led teams of Junior and Senior level engineers (geo-located around the globe)
positions.insights: Continuous Integration and Continuous Delivery (CI/CD), Kubernetes and +6 skills

positions.title: Principal Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Technical Lead and Architect for Developer Outer Loop (CI/CD) of the Mixed Reality Organization. Operated horizontally across hundreds of engineers and multiple technology stacks.
- Led delivery of the engineering systems and tools (Build, test, orchestration) powering the SDLC for Microsoft’s AR/VR products (Microsoft HoloLens, Windows Mixed Reality, Azure Remote Rendering, OpenXR ToolKit). 
- Led cross-functional groups to build out large scale hardware test labs for CI, including leading the design and delivery of remote device execution platforms.
- Worked with stakeholders at all levels to define and run the product release sign-off processes.
- Mentored engineers within the organization and outside of it; participated in company-wide coaching programs for early-in-career employees.

Highlighted Results/Deliverables:

- Fully designed and implemented the cloud-native in-house workflow orchestration system ("Conductor") that powered Mixed Reality CI/CD, automated failure analysis, crash dump processing, and artifact management (Thousands of workflows/day). Built on top of Azure VMs, Azure Functions, Azure ServiceBus, Azure Blob Storage, CosmosDB, and Azure SQL Server. 
- Architected the full design and successfully led the implementation of a remote device execution platform ("Reverb") built on Azure IoT Hub, enabling developers around the world to run CI against on-prem labs of AR/VR hardware.
- Led the migration of internal CI/CD tools and workflows from legacy on-prem systems to geo-replicated, cloud-native infra.
positions.insights: Azure DevOps, Microsoft Azure and +10 skills

positions.title: Senior Software Engineer
positions.description:
- Improved organization code velocity and quality by defining and driving the daily build assessment process for HoloLens 1’s entire SW platform team. Implemented the supporting reporting and analysis tools (ASP.NET)
- Restructured and optimized how test and product code was built in the Windows code base to achieve a 20% improvement in build times for the entire organization.
- Built on top of company-wide tools to provide a solution that enabled developers to execute complex automated test scenarios from their desk against prerelease AR/VR HW in a lab with a few button clicks.
- Designed and built an infrastructure-as-code solution for defining automated test suites + execution plans in AR/VR. Contributed core pieces of the implementation back into the MSFT DevProd ecosystem & drove adoption by the entire Windows organization (~20k engineers).
- Worked as part of a cross-org group to design and bring up robust internal test labs capable of self-healing and recovery

positions.title: Software Development Engineer in Test II (SDET II)
positions.description:
- Drove all-up test automation readiness and reliability efforts across a team of ~20 SDETs for Windows 8/8.1 inbox client apps: People, Mail, and Calendar.
- Owned and developed full test specifications and test case design for features in the same suite of apps
- Implemented highly-reliable, effective, UI-driven test automation for features in the same suite of apps
- Primary areas of test focus: UI views/controls in Mail and Calendar applications, third-party social interaction experience between app suite and Facebook/Twitter.

honors.title: Microsoft Gold Star Award
honors.description: Awarded Microsoft Gold Star for successfully organizing and driving to completion a team-wide (~10 engineers) automated test quality improvement effort to significantly improve reliability and usefulness of team's functional test automation suite. Effort was completed and award received within first two months at the company.

honors.title: ESRI 2009 Scholarship Recipient
honors.description: Received ESRI Scholarship Award in 2009 - scholarship provided for computer science students showing exemplary academic performance alongside a body of work focused in geospatial information systems (GIS).
